mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of reasons being offered for a conclusion."
Arguments in logic are composed of reasons being offered for a conclusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the distinctive subject matter of logic."
Argument is the distinctive subject matter of logic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most fundamental skill common to math, physics, psychology, history, literary studies, and any other intellectual endeavor."
Evaluating arguments is the most fundamental skill common to math, physics, psychology, history, literary studies, and any other intellectual endeavor.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a little different from verifiable or evaluative claims, in that the latter discusses what was, is, or will be, while the former describes what ought to have been or ought to be."

Advocatory claims are a little different from verifiable or evaluative claims, in that the latter discusses what was, is, or will be, while the former describes what ought to have been or ought to be.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the series of statements which is supposed to do the actual explaining."
The explanans is the series of statements which is supposed to do the actual explaining.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the root of many troubles in the world. v."
Scarcity of food is the root of many troubles in the world. v.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the event or phenomenon or thing which is supposed to be explained."
The explanandum is the event or phenomenon or thing which is supposed to be explained.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a process that allows the establishment of a certain proposition (the conclusion) from other set(s) of propositions (the premisses) which constitute the evidence for the establishment of the former."

Inference ordinarily is a process that allows the establishment of a certain proposition (the conclusion) from other set(s) of propositions (the premisses) which constitute the evidence for the establishment of the former.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a primary virtue of inductive arguments."
character is a primary virtue of inductive arguments.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to represent categorical propositions, whose logical relations were first studied systematically by in traditional logic."
Two-circle Venn diagrams are used to represent categorical propositions, whose logical relations were first studied systematically by in traditional logic.
fib: ______ is a proposition that relates two classes of objects.
categorical proposition
A categorical proposition is a proposition that relates two classes of objects.
______ is the most qualified person for the job.
Amarachi
Amarachi is the most qualified person for the job.
______ is the sum and substance of logic.
argument structure
The argument structure is the sum and substance of logic.
______ are the foundation of the state. xi.
people
The people are the foundation of the state. xi.
______ is used for statements about morality, ethics, duty, and so on.
advocatory form
The advocatory form is used for statements about morality, ethics, duty, and so on.
______ is that which provides reason(s) for the acceptance of the conclusion, which is the claim in the argument.
premise
The premise is that which provides reason(s) for the acceptance of the conclusion, which is the claim in the argument.
______ is the same regardless of which of the two propositions is regarded as the original statement.
relation between contradictories
The relation between contradictories is the same regardless of which of the two propositions is regarded as the original statement.
______ is an argument just the denial of what the other person says.
Nor
Nor is an argument just the denial of what the other person says.
______ is considered valid (good) or not valid (not good) even if we do not understand the inference right away.
logical relation
The logical relation is considered valid (good) or not valid (not good) even if we do not understand the inference right away.
